name: Kingdom of Jiaodong (Eighteen Kingdoms)
alt: Kingdom of Jiaodong under Xiang Yu

predecessors.name: Qi (state)
predecessors.text: eastern Shandong, one of the 'Three Qis' cut from the former Qi state

ledger.x: 206: Xiang Yu cuts Jiaodong from Qi and makes Tian Fu its king.
206: Tian Rong conquers Jiaodong and kills its king.
206: the Kingdom of Jiaodong ends and Tian Rong's Qi holds eastern Shandong.

wars.name: Revolt of Tian Rong against the Three Qis
wars.outcome: Qi (Tian Rong) victory: 'Tian Rong conquers the Kingdom of Jiaodong and kills its king, Tian Fu' (Timeline, 206 BC); Jiaodong and Jibei were reunited with Qi.

certainty.note: The kingdom was assigned by Xiang Yu from the old Qi; no survey or treaty lines; the outline is Cliopatria's approximation.
